references.text: God commands Moses to designate cities of refuge in the land of Canaan, which forms the basis for the commandment regarding three cities in Deuteronomy 19:2.
Moses set apart three cities of refuge on the east side of the Jordan, complementing the three cities to be designated in the Promised Land.
Joshua fulfills the command by designating the cities of refuge after Israel had taken possession of the land.
The earliest mention of a place of refuge for someone who kills another unintentionally, which is the precursor to the cities of refuge.
God establishes that there shall be six cities of refuge in total, three of which are to be in the land that the Lord gives them.
Shechem was given as a city of refuge in the hill country of Ephraim, one of the three cities on the west side of the Jordan.
